text: Best friends Marie and Alex drive to [Alex's parents' secluded farmhouse|trigger|travelling somewhere remote] for a weekend of study. That first night [a man with a straight razor|threat|people who kill] rings the doorbell and butchers the family while Marie hides under her bed, and Alex is chained and [dragged into the killer's truck|images|vehicles and roads]. Armed with a kitchen knife, Marie follows down a deserted road, driven by a devotion to Alex [that will let no one come between them|wants|a lover to possess].
